# Basecoat 1.0.2 — Nova

Unmodified `dist/basecoat-nova.cdn.min.css` from the npm `basecoat-css@1.0.2`
package. MIT license included. https://basecoatui.com/installation/

Upstream: https://github.com/hunvreus/basecoat
Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/basecoat-css/-/basecoat-css-1.0.2.tgz

The standalone stylesheet is bundled locally for CSP and offline compatibility.
No Tailwind build, CDN request, Basecoat JavaScript, or custom select/dialog runtime
is needed by Schness. `ui.css` adapts its controls to the existing theme tokens;
`styles.css` retains board, piece, motion, and responsive game-layout ownership.
